items.head: 8461f9ae7259d523741ef324675472c55b2e84cf
items.title: fix: reject blank coach identities and normalize team access
items.body: Team read and save gates now share normalized, nonempty coach identity checks. Blank identities cannot acquire unassigned teams. Thirteen focused permission tests pass.

items.head: a6086bdbee679b963ec7f3e99233c87ace8d5284
items.title: fix: remove remaining billing status from player roster responses
items.body: Player responses now neutralize payment plan, deposit, waiver and overage status. Parent billing and player statistics remain available. Twelve focused tests pass.

items.head: 24337a90258e1588851303d970bf6cdcd71e7713
items.title: fix: hide staff employment records from family team views
items.body: Family responses neutralize staff child linkage, tax/compliance status and expiry fields. Coach and admin records are preserved. Twelve focused permission tests pass.

items.head: 36efbd3d6c49204ade2eb19c32bd7b4c580b4ab9
items.title: fix: protect athlete row identifier ownership during scoped saves
items.body: Scoped row saves reject duplicate identifiers and identifiers already belonging to another athlete. Athlete-keyed intake/recruiting profiles remain supported. Eight focused tests pass.

items.head: 5881c5b17d8e58b41d98dc020c95811ac380219a
items.title: fix: reject duplicate prescription versions before appending history
items.body: Append-only strength and throwing prescriptions reject duplicate new version IDs, preserving immutable existing history. Seven focused tests pass.

items.head: 371226b7aa24329e63606e1396618529be8379af
items.title: fix: reject duplicate newly submitted development messages
items.body: Scoped message saves reject duplicate newly submitted IDs while retaining existing history and permissions. Seven focused tests pass.

items.head: ad20db9fe752a06ba0099d4f129cc745bf43f643
items.title: fix: validate unique team and team-local staff identifiers
items.body: Club saves reject blank or duplicate team IDs and team-local staff IDs. Staff can legitimately serve multiple teams. Two focused tests pass.

items.head: 47f2fdbfeee37ee9192dd774fb57ed97c313c1ee
items.title: fix: project development viewers without internal identity grants
items.body: Development responses now use an explicit viewer projection. Player viewers omit guardian emails; internal IDs and grants stay server-side while guardian lookup emails remain supported. Two focused tests pass.
